description: Declare an LLM provider credential and surface its health as a Dagster asset -- an api-key-presence check (always on) and an opt-in live models-list API call, plus the models the provider offers.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: LiteLLM provider id, e.g. openai, anthropic, gemini, azure, bedrock, groq, mistral, cohere, vertex_ai -- same vocabulary litellm_agent's `model` field implies (e.g. 'gemini/gemini-2.5-flash' -> provider 'gemini').

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding this provider's API key. Only its presence is checked and only its name is ever stored in this component's config -- the value is read fresh from the environment at check time, never templated into a typed field or logged.

api_base_env_var.label: Api Base Env Var
api_base_env_var.description: Env var holding a custom API base URL (proxies, self-hosted gateways, Azure endpoints).

models.label: Models
models.description: Curated list of model ids this provider is offered for. When unset, falls back to LiteLLM's own static model catalog for `provider`.

test_call.label: Test Call
test_call.description: When true, adds a second asset check that makes one real models-list API call to the provider using the live key, to verify it actually authenticates -- not just that the env var is set. Costs one real network call per check run; silently reported as 'not supported' rather than failed for providers with no live models-list endpoint in this litellm version.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: Check severity when a check fails: 'WARN' or 'ERROR'.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on.
